## What's new

- **Clearer preset categories:** in the Presets panel, each category heading is highlighted, shows how many presets it holds, and has a line under it.

## Fixes

- **Presets panel opens instantly:** switching from Tiles to Presets no longer takes about a second.
  - The panel stays ready once opened.
  - Thumbnails are drawn once and kept, only when they scroll into view, and in the background so the panel appears straight away.
